What it is

Open source systems engineering templates for small teams used to increase traceability, teach others, and learn more about structured engineering practices. The user guide and downloads are at syseng-toolkit.github.io.

What I did
  • Designed the templates in accordance to V model and ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288, with full versioning and release notes.
  • Templates include Requirements Documents, Bill of Materials, Risk Registers, Trade studies, etc.
  • Use the toolkit on my own projects for full traceability in every personal project
Result
  • Templates for requirements, bill of materials, risk register, trade studies, etc. are live right now for view and download!
